basic_info.description: Presidio Heights gem available for the first time in decades, well located near Presidio Heights shopping and public transit.    Flats have City views and all share a pleasant garden sitting area in the back.     Top floor tenant is no longer under Rent Control Regulations due to Landlord Petition prevailing at August 2025 Rent Board meeting.    More information at: https://542-544presidioave.com
